proof_body:
by
  intro f f₁ a s t hst hf hd hle
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun u => f u * Real.exp (-(a * u))) (Set.Icc s t) :=
    hf.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).neg).continuousOn
  have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun u => f u * Real.exp (-(a * u))) (Set.Icc s t) := by
    refine antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos
      (f' := fun u => (f₁ u - a * f u) * Real.exp (-(a * u))) (convex_Icc s t) hcont ?_ ?_
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro u hu
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -(a * u)) (-(a * 1)) u :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul a).neg
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun u => f u * Real.exp (-(a * u)))
          (f₁ u * Real.exp (-(a * u)) + f u * (Real.exp (-(a * u)) * (-(a * 1)))) u :=
        (hd u hu).mul h1.exp
      exact (h2.congr_deriv (by ring)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro u hu
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.2 (hle u hu)) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h : f t * Real.exp (-(a * t)) ≤ f s * Real.exp (-(a * s)) :=
    hanti (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hst) (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 hst) hst
  have hE : Real.exp (a * (t - s)) = Real.exp (a * t) * Real.exp (-(a * s)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hone : Real.exp (-(a * t)) * Real.exp (a * t) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  calc f t = f t * Real.exp (-(a * t)) * Real.exp (a * t) := by rw [mul_assoc, hone, mul_one]
    _ ≤ f s * Real.exp (-(a * s)) * Real.exp (a * t) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = f s * Real.exp (a * (t - s)) := by rw [hE]; ring
target_source: ∀ (f f₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (a s t : ℝ), s ≤ t → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc s t) → (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo s t, HasDerivAt f (f₁ u) u) → (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo s t, f₁ u ≤ a * f u) → f t ≤ f s * Real.exp (a * (t - s))
